mapper.sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.target_dept_id, c.plan_start_date, c.plan_end_date, c.status, c.remark, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, d.dept_name AS target_dept_name, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM apms_athlete a WHERE a.status != '2' AND (c.target_dept_id IS NULL OR a.primary_team_id = c.target_dept_id)) AS member_total, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.athlete_id) FROM apms_body_measure m WHERE m.cycle_id = c.id) AS measured_count FROM apms_measure_cycle c LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON c.target_dept_id = d.dept_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO apms_measure_cycle (name, target_dept_id, plan_start_date, plan_end_date, status, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{targetDeptId}, #{planStartDate}, #{planEndDate}, #{status}'0', #{remark}, #{createBy}, NOW(), #{updateBy}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE apms_body_measure SET cycle_id = NULL WHERE cycle_id = #{cycleId}
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.athlete_id, m.measure_date, m.height, m.weight, m.sit_height, m.body_fat_rate, m.waist, m.data_source, m.cycle_id, m.create_by, m.create_time, a.name AS athlete_name, d.dept_name AS athlete_team FROM apms_body_measure m LEFT JOIN apms_athlete a ON m.athlete_id = a.athlete_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON a.primary_team_id = d.dept_id WHERE m.cycle_id = #{cycleId} ORDER BY d.dept_name, a.jersey_no, a.athlete_id

SELECT m.id, m.athlete_id, m.measure_date, m.height, m.weight, m.sit_height, m.body_fat_rate, m.waist, m.data_source, m.cycle_id FROM apms_body_measure m WHERE m.cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND m.athlete_id = #{athleteId} LIMIT 1
